I am 73 years old. I have farmed this land for 55 years since my father handed it to me when I was 18. I only went to primary school, but I know my fields better than any book. My family has seven mouths, and my son and daughter-in-law work in Handan city sending some money home. My wife and I do most of the work ourselves, and we hire old Li for a few days at harvest when the wheat must come in fast.

I have 10.1 mu total. Seven mu I do wheat then maize, same as always. The other 3.1 mu I grow cotton. I do not change what works. Last year was okay — not great, not bad — so this year I do almost the same. I watch my neighbors. If Lao Zhang and the others use about the same amounts, I do not want to be the fool who tries something different and loses his shirt.

For the wheat, it is already in the ground. I planted Jimai 22, an improved variety I trust. Last fall I rotary tilled the seven mu and put one full bag — 50 kg — of compound fertilizer per mu as base. Now in spring I irrigate at green-up, and at jointing I spread half a bag of urea, about 25 kg per mu. If the plants look a little yellow at heading I will throw another 10 kg of urea per mu. I irrigate four times total: the winter water, green-up, jointing, and grain filling. Two sprays — one for weeds, one for rust or bugs. I expect about 450 kg per mu.

For summer maize, after I cut the wheat in early June there is no time to rest. I plant Zhengdan 958 hybrid seed directly into the wheat stubble, no tillage — just open the rows and drop the seed. At planting I put 30 kg per mu of compound fertilizer in the rows. At big trumpet stage I topdress with 25 kg of urea per mu. Irrigate twice, three times if July is dry. Two sprays. Should get 500 kg per mu.

For cotton, I rotary till the 3.1 mu in April. I plant improved cotton seed. Base fertilizer is 30 kg per mu of compound fertilizer. I topdress with urea twice during the season. Irrigate three times — flowering and boll stages need water most. Four sprays for bollworm, that devil never sleeps. I expect about 250 kg of seed cotton per mu.

Why these amounts? Because that is what I did last year, and last year was fine. Fertilizer costs real money — about 200 yuan per mu for wheat — but losing yield is worse. A bad harvest means I cannot help pay for my grandson's school. Better to put a little too much than too little. I sleep better knowing I fed my crops well.
